brief:
Five cooking gas trucks entered Gaza, the General Petroleum Authority announced, calling on residents to verify beneficiary lists as the territory faces an ongoing fuel shortage. The authority did not specify when the shipment arrived or provide details on distribution plans.

The announcement came as Gaza continues to grapple with severe energy deficits affecting households, hospitals, and basic services across the enclave.

title: Gaza fuel authority confirms entry of five gas trucks
